plugins.name: halfhand
plugins.description: Skills from the builds at halfhand.dev: fit-check (text fit at nine widths), prepublish-leak-check (secrets and setup details before publishing), dust-wallet (a self-funded Midnight wallet that pays its fees in DUST), capped-cage (invariants and attack tests for a contract that holds funds next to an operator key), page-watch (a scheduled report of stale or broken public pages), sealed-count-proof (proving a count over sealed values on Midnight, with a test kit), city-driver-starter (a first driver for your own Midnight City agent: pause and honest logs).
